name: Metathesis (OCT)
principle: Ethylene and butenes (or other C4/C5 olefin streams) are reacted over a metathesis catalyst to make propylene. Lummus's olefins conversion technology (OCT) takes feeds from dilute ethylene to polymer-grade ethylene and from steam-cracker, MTBE-raffinate or FCC C4 streams, and gives polymer-grade propylene at about 94 to 95% selectivity.

process_steps.name: Product separation with ethylene and butene recycles

source.note: Lummus Technology, olefins conversion technology sheet, 15 October 2020

performance.metric: steam cracker ethylene output when integrated with OCT
performance.basis: propylene-to-ethylene ratio can be raised above 1.0
